The carry-propagation delay of each FA is 12 ns and the sum propagation delay of each FA is 15 ns. The worst-case delay (in ns) of this 16-bit adder will be _____.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a 16-bit serial carry adder, composed of multiple full adders cascaded. It can be seen that from left to right they are labeled FA0, FA1, several stages are omitted in the middle, and then FA14 and FA15. The top of each stage has the corresponding inputs Ai, Bi, and the bottom has the corresponding sum output Si; adjacent full adders are connected by horizontal carry signals, for example FA0 outputs C0 to FA1, FA1 outputs C1 and continues to pass it to the right, FA14 outputs C14 to FA15, and finally FA15 outputs C15. Reasoning: In the worst case, the carry that affects the highest-bit sum output S15 needs first to be generated by the lowest bit FA0 as C0, then pass sequentially through FA1 to FA14, forming C14 that reaches FA15. Thus there are 15 carry propagation delays from FA0 to FA14, each being 12 ns, so the delay before the carry reaches FA15 is 15 × 12 = 180 ns. Then FA15 generates the highest-bit sum S15 according to the arrived carry, requiring one sum propagation delay of 15 ns. Therefore the total worst-case delay is 180 + 15 = 195 ns.

raw_record.question_text: A 16-bit ripple carry adder is realized using 16 identical full adders (FA) as shown in the image. The carry-propagation delay of each FA is 12 ns and the sum propagation delay of each FA is 15 ns. The worst-case delay (in ns) of this 16-bit adder will be _____.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it shows FA0, FA1, omitted intermediate FAs, FA14, and FA15 connected serially by carry signals C0, C1, ..., C14, C15, with sums S0 through S15 at the bottom. Trace the worst-case path that affects S15: a carry must be produced by FA0, ripple through FA1 up to FA14 to become C14, and then FA15 must produce S15. Count 15 carry-propagation steps from FA0 output C0 through arrival of C14 at FA15, then add one sum-propagation delay in FA15. Compute 15×12 ns + 15 ns = 195 ns.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个16位串行进位加法器，由多个全加器级联组成。可以看到左到右依次标有 FA0、FA1，中间省略若干级，然后是 FA14 和 FA15。每一级顶部有对应输入 Ai、Bi，底部有对应和输出 Si；相邻全加器之间通过水平进位信号连接，例如 FA0 输出 C0 到 FA1，FA1 输出 C1 继续向右传递，FA14 输出 C14 到 FA15，最后 FA15 输出 C15。推理：最坏情况下，影响最高位和输出 S15 的进位需要先由最低位 FA0 产生 C0，然后依次经过 FA1 到 FA14，形成到达 FA15 的 C14。这样共有从 FA0 到 FA14 的 15 个进位传播延迟，每个为 12 ns，因此进位到达 FA15 前的延迟为 15 × 12 = 180 ns。随后 FA15 根据到达的进位产生最高位和 S15，需要一个和传播延迟 15 ns。因此最坏情况总延迟为 180 + 15 = 195 ns。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the ripple chain begins at FA0 and ends at FA15, with carry links C0, C1, ..., C14 feeding the next full adder and final carry C15 leaving FA15; each stage also has a sum output Si. Build arrival times. The carry out of FA0 arrives at 12 ns, and in general Ck arrives after (k+1)×12 ns, so C15 arrives after 16×12 = 192 ns. For sums, S0 can appear after 15 ns, and for stage i≥1, its carry input has rippled through i carry steps, so Si arrives after i×12 + 15 ns. The largest sum time is S15 = 15×12 + 15 = 195 ns. Compare 195 ns with final carry time 192 ns; the worst case is 195 ns.
method.CoT_raw: Image description: The figure shows a ripple-carry adder made of full-adder blocks arranged from left to right: FA0, FA1, omitted middle stages, FA14, and FA15. Each block has inputs Ai and Bi at the top and a sum output Si at the bottom. The carry output of each stage feeds the next stage: FA0 produces C0 into FA1, FA1 produces C1 toward later stages, FA14 produces C14 into FA15, and FA15 produces the final carry C15. Reasoning: The carry-propagation delay per full adder is 12 ns. Thus the final carry C15 appears after 16 carry propagations, so its delay is 16 × 12 = 192 ns. For sum outputs, S0 can appear after 15 ns. For stage i ≥ 1, the carry must ripple through i previous stages before that stage can generate its sum, so Si appears after i × 12 + 15 ns. The largest sum delay is for S15: 15 × 12 + 15 = 180 + 15 = 195 ns. Comparing the final carry delay 192 ns and the last sum delay 195 ns, the worst-case delay is 195 ns.
